general: Tell me honestly. Do you know where we are going?
I know where we have been. That has to count for something.
We have been walking since before it was light.
And we will be walking after it is dark. That is the arrangement.
If this all ends badly, I want it written down that I said so.
It is written down. You say it every week.
Do you ever think about going home?
Home is wherever the packs are.
That is a very sad thing to be at peace with.
You have been quiet all day.
I was thinking. It happens.
Tell me again why we took this road.
Because you asked, and I said yes. Fool that I am.
I would not have made it this far alone.
Nor I. Do not let it go to your head.
How is that wound of yours holding up?
It has stopped bleeding, which is something.
If we get paid, I am buying the first round.
You said that in the last three towns.
Do you trust the people we met back there?
I trust nobody I cannot outrun.
You carry too much. Give me half.
I can manage. Ask me again on the hill.
One of these days we should stop for a whole week.
A week. Listen to us.
What did you do before all this?
Something quieter. I do not miss it as much as I should.
How much money have we actually got?
{gold} gold, and half of it is spoken for.
So the answer is no, then.
Say we found somewhere decent tomorrow. Would you stop?
Ask me tomorrow. I am too tired to be honest tonight.
Who is leading this, exactly?
{leader} walks in front. That is not quite the same thing.
I dreamed we were still walking.
That is not a dream, that is a memory arriving early.
I had a dream about this place. Do not ask.
You always dream about the wrong things.
One of these days I will dream about the right one and you will owe me an apology.
Do you think anyone is looking for us?
Somebody always is. It is who that changes.
We should agree on what we do if it goes wrong.
We run. That is the plan. It has never let us down.
I have been counting the days.
How many?
I lost count. That is my point.
Nobody warned me the boring parts would be the worst.
Nobody warned me about any of it.
Your boots are finished.
My boots have been finished since spring. They have not been told.
I keep expecting somebody to come and take charge.
That was the job nobody applied for.
What is the first thing you buy, if we ever come out of this rich?
Silence. A whole room of it.
We are getting good at this.
We are getting used to it. Do not confuse the two.
If I go down, do not carry me. Take the pack and go.
I will carry you and complain the entire way.
I have stopped asking what is over the next hill.
Good. The answer has been disappointing four times running.
Say something interesting. Anything.
The word for a group of crows is a murder.
I regret asking.
Are we the good ones in this?
We are the ones still walking. Ask a historian about the rest.
Do you remember the name of that town? The one with the bells?
No. But I remember the bells.
I want one day where nothing at all happens.
You would be unbearable by noon.
We have not talked properly in weeks.
We are talking now.
This is not talking. This is walking with noise.
What would you be doing right now, if none of this had happened?
Something with fewer hills in it.
That is not an answer. That is a complaint with a hat on.
You have not asked me a single question about myself in a month.
I assumed you would say it when you wanted to.
That is either very considerate or very lazy.
Who taught you to fight like that?
Nobody. That is rather the problem.
I have been keeping a list of everything we are owed.
By whom?
That is the weakness in the list, yes.
Do you think we have changed?
You have got quieter and I have got worse. So yes.
If you could take one thing back out of all of it, what would it be?
Ask me something easier. Ask me about the weather.
Nobody out here knows our names.
That has been the single best part of the last year.
We are going to run out of money before we run out of road.
We have been in that state since the day we met. Keep walking.
Watch out for that one. They are pleasant, and pleasant is expensive.
Noted. And if they are simply pleasant?
Then I will have been wrong twice this year.
How do you sleep, out here, with all of it?
Badly, and then all at once.
That is the most honest thing you have said to me.
We should decide now who carries what if we have to run.
You take the money, I take the water. Neither of us takes the tent.
Say we finish this. Say it actually ends. Then what?
Then I find out whether I am any good at ordinary days.
I do not think either of us is doing this for the money any more.
Speak for yourself. I am doing it entirely for the money.
You could at least pretend to think about it before answering.
Every town we pass is somebody's whole life.
And we are two strangers walking through the middle of it. Try to be polite.
There is something I should have told you a while ago.
Then tell me on the road. I would rather hear it moving.
battered: Nobody here is in a fit state to fight anything.
Then we do not fight. We sit down and we mend.
Look at us. All three of us, if we are counting.
I would rather not be counted just now.
We are one bad afternoon from being buried in a field.
Then let us have a good afternoon. For once.
Everyone is hurt. Not one of us is pretending otherwise any more.
That is the first honest thing said all day.
If something comes at us now, it takes us.
Then we stop. Here. Whatever it costs us in hours.
We are in a bad way and we need to stop.
needAll: Hungry, filthy, and none of us has slept. Have I missed anything?
You have missed that we are also broke.
When did this stop being an expedition and start being an ordeal?
Two towns back. Nobody wanted to say.
We are running the whole party on nothing.
People last longer on nothing than you would think. Not much longer.
I want a bath, a bed and a meal, in whichever order they arrive.
Pick one. That is the budget.
We are not in a state to meet anybody.
Then we meet nobody. We find a roof and we lie down.
This is how parties disappear, you know. Not in battles.

hunger: When did we last eat properly?
That is an answer, and I hate it.
My stomach has started making decisions for me.
Then let it choose the next town.
I would eat something I could not name right now.
Is there anything left in the pack?
There is something in the pack. Whether it is food is a matter of opinion.
sleep: I have not slept properly in days.
None of us have. You are just the one saying it.
I could sleep standing up, and I think I have been.
You have. You walked into a fence.
Wake me at the next town.
You are the one walking in front.
Talk to me. If I stop hearing a voice I am going down.
Then I will talk. About anything. Do not fall over.
hygiene: Do not stand downwind of me.
I have not stood upwind of you since the marsh.
We smell like something died on the road behind us.
Something did. We stepped over it.
I want water. Not to drink. To stand in.
The next river we cross, we stop. I promise.
No town is letting us in looking like this.
Then we wash in the next stream, like animals with standards.
social: I have not spoken to anyone but you in a week.
We should go somewhere with people in it.
People come with prices and questions.
I miss the noise of a room full of strangers.
You will change your mind in the first tavern.
Say something. Anything. I need a voice that is not the wind.
You are talking to the wrong person for company, but I will try.
leisure: Everything we do lately is either walking or bleeding.
There is also carrying. You forgot carrying.
I want to play something. Cards, dice, anything with rules that do not kill you.
Find me a table and I will lose to you honestly.
When did we stop enjoying any of this?
Around the third ambush. It crept up.
One evening. One evening where we are not preparing for something.
I will hold you to that.

forest: Nothing in here makes the noise it should.
It is the trees. They take the edges off everything, footsteps included.
We have passed that same crooked trunk twice.
Trees repeat themselves. That is their whole trick.
I have never trusted a place where you cannot see the horizon.
The horizon is overrated. It is what is at knee height that gets you.
Something is following us through the undergrowth.
Probably. Keep walking and do not look interesting.
It smells green in here. Green and old.
That is rot doing its work. It is the same smell either way.
plains: Nowhere for anyone else either. I will take that trade.
This is farmland. Somebody works this.
Then somebody will want to know who is walking through it.
I can see for an hour in every direction and there is nothing in it.
Enjoy it. It will not last.
The grass has been flattened along there. Cart, I think.
Then there is a road, and where there is a road there is a bed.
desert: The heat is doing something to my judgement.
Your judgement was doing badly before the heat.
We should have filled everything at the last water.
We should have. Say it once and then stop.
There is nothing out here. Not even a bird.
Something eats out here. It just does not do it in daylight.
Every stone looks the same as the last.
Then walk towards the low sun and stop reading the stones.
ice: I cannot feel the ends of my fingers.
Then keep them moving. Numb is the warning, not the injury.
Snow covers everything. Tracks, holes, whatever is under the crust.
So walk where I walk and do not improvise.
It is very beautiful and it is trying to kill us.
Most beautiful things are managing both.
How long can a person walk in this?
Longer than they think. Once. Never twice.
mountain: I can hear my own heart in my ears.
That is the height. It passes, or you do.
One bad step here is the whole story.
Look at the drop. Just look at it.
I have looked. Now face the rock and keep going.
Whatever is over this ridge had better be worth the climb.
It is another ridge. It is always another ridge.
water: I do not like water I cannot see the bottom of.
Then do not look down. Problem solved.
The packs will not thank us for this crossing.
Neither will the boots. Hold them over your head.
Salt in the air. We are close to something.
Close to somewhere with a harbour, and harbours have inns.
Then we go along the shore, not through it.
wetland: Every step here takes something back out of me.
The ground is drinking. Lift your knees.
My boots are full of the swamp.
Your boots were full of the swamp an hour ago. This is the swamp getting acquainted.
The air in here is thick enough to chew.
Breathe through your sleeve and do not drink anything standing still.
Then we cross it quickly and we do not sleep here.
underground: Keep your voice down. Sound travels strangely down here.
It travels perfectly. That is the problem.
Somebody dug this. That is what bothers me.
Somebody dug it and then somebody stopped digging. Ask why.
I have lost all sense of which way is out.
Follow the draught. Air knows the way.
The dark down here is a different dark.
It is the same dark. There is just more of it and no morning coming.
Watch the ceiling as much as the floor.
Now I am watching both and enjoying neither.
ruins: People lived here. Properly lived here.
And then they did not. That is the part worth studying.
Somebody took the doors. Every single door.
Doors are worth money. Grief is not.
And now it is a place we walk through on the way somewhere else.
Do not take anything out of a grave. I mean it.
You were considering it. I watched you consider it.
urban: Eyes are fine. It is the ones that follow you into the next street.
Everything costs money in a place like this. Even standing still.
Then let us stand still somewhere cheaper.
I had forgotten what a crowd sounds like.
Give it an hour. You will be sick of it.
Stay where I can see you. Cities eat people.
Cities eat people who look lost. So stop staring upwards.
road: A proper road. I could weep.
Do not. It will only be mud again by evening.
Roads mean traffic, and traffic means somebody to ask.
And somebody to be asked by. Keep the answers short.
Then somebody collects for it. Have a story ready.
We have made better time today than the last three days together.
Say that quietly. The road will hear you.
industrial: Whatever was made here, they made a great deal of it.
And then they left in a hurry. Look at the benches.
Do not lick anything and we will be fine.
I do not trust a floor with that much machinery under it.
Somebody could still be running this.
Somebody or something. Assume the worse one.
interior: Feels wrong being inside after so long out.
Give it ten minutes. Then it will feel wrong to leave.
Somebody keeps this place. Look how clean the sills are.
So we behave, and we do not open the locked one.
Everything makes you anxious. At least this one is warm.
Do not sit on anything until we know whose it is.
Too late, and it is very comfortable.
otherworldly: I do not think we should be here.
I do not think here should be here.
The light is coming from the wrong direction.
The light is coming from no direction. Stop looking at it.
My eyes keep sliding off the edges of things.
Then look at your own boots and keep walking.
If I start saying strange things, hit me.
You already are. I let it pass.
I noticed an hour ago. I was hoping you would not.

battle_won: That was closer than the last one.
They are all closer than the last one. That is the shape of it.
{ev_enemies}. I will be seeing that for a while.
Then look at me instead. It is over.
{ev_gold} out of it, after all that.
It buys bread. Bread is not nothing.
Did you see what it did before it went down?
I saw. I would rather not go over it while we are still out here.
battle_boss: {ev_name} is dead. I still do not quite believe it.
Believe it in the morning. Walk now.
Level {ev_level}, that thing. And we are standing here.
Barely. Do not let it make us brave.
Somebody kept {ev_name} down there on purpose.
Then somebody is going to notice it is gone.
battle_lost: We should not have taken that fight.
No. We should not. It is said. Now leave it.
And we are still here to say so. Only just.
I keep going back over it.
Go back over it later. Out loud, with a drink. Not now.
battle_fled: It usually is. It never feels like it.
We left nothing that was worth what it would have cost.
Nobody enjoys running. That is what makes it a decision.
battle_arena: A streak of {ev_streak}. People were shouting our names.
People were shouting. The names were approximate.
We could make a living in there.
We could make a short and popular living in there.
party_join: What do you make of {ev_name}, honestly?
Ask me in a month. Everyone is pleasant in the first week.
{ev_name} came in at level {ev_level}. That is not nothing.
Levels are not the part I worry about.
A {ev_cls} is exactly what we were short of.
We were short of everything. Do not oversell it.
party_leave: Has anyone actually said {ev_name}'s name since?
You just did. That is the first time.
I keep leaving room in the line for {ev_name}.
I know. I have been walking around the gap too.
party_death: {ev_name} should not have been in front.
{ev_name} was always in front. That was the whole of them.
I have nothing useful to say about {ev_name}.
Then say something useless. It is better than the quiet.
We buried {ev_name} at {ev_place} and walked on the same hour.
That is what we had. It was not disrespect.
party_retire: Somebody had to prove it could be done.
party_level: {ev_name} came out of that different. Sharper.
Level {ev_level} does that. Give it a week to settle.
It happens all at once, or it does not happen.
shop_buy: {ev_items}. Was that everything on the list?
There was no list. That was the problem.
And we would spend it again. That is the annoying part.
shop_sell: Less than it was worth. More than it weighed.
I miss some of what we sold.
You miss the idea of it. You never once used it.
item_found: Nothing is just lying there. Somebody put it down and did not come back.
Do we split what we find, or does it go in the pack?
In the pack. We are not doing ledgers on a hillside.
item_artifactGot: I know. I can feel it through the canvas.
Should we be carrying {ev_item} at all?
Somebody is going to. Better us than whoever wanted it.
Let them come. We will be somewhere else.
rest_sleep: {ev_hours} hours. I had forgotten what that feels like.
You looked almost human at breakfast.
Best sleep in weeks and I still woke up tired.
That is the road catching up. It takes more than one night.
place_entered: It was bigger in the telling. They always are.
We walked into {ev_place} at {ev_time}. Remember that.
Because one of us should be writing this down.
floor_changed: Floor {ev_floor}. We are a long way in.
The way out is the same length. Save something for it.
Every floor down is warmer. Have you noticed?
I noticed. I have been trying not to think about why.
health_disease: Then we slow down, and we do not argue about it.
How long does this one take to turn?
Days, if we are lucky. Hours if we are not.
health_partLost: {ev_name} lost something back there that does not grow back.
I was there. I do not need it summarised.
Nobody has asked {ev_name} how they are.
Nobody has asked because nobody has an answer ready for it.
health_augmentFit: How does it feel? The new one.
Like borrowing a hand. It will be mine eventually.
I still cannot look at it directly.
Then look at my face. It has not changed.
crime_committed: That was {ev_bounty} on our heads for nothing.
Not for nothing. For {ev_crime}. Say it properly.
Are we the sort who do that now?
We are the sort who did it once. Let us leave it at once.
quest_accepted: Do we even know what we agreed to back at {ev_place}?
We agreed to {ev_quest}. The details are somebody else's job.
Every job sounds simple in the room where it is offered.
Then let us hear it again outside, in the rain.
quest_completed: Do not say finished. Say finished for now.
That is one thing that went the way it was meant to.
Mark the day. It does not happen often.
skill_learned: Good. I would rather learn it now than need it later.
Watching somebody better at it than me. Repeatedly.
npc_romance: Do not. Whatever you were about to say, do not.
I am not going to ask about {ev_npc}.
You have asked twice already, without words.
pet_join: It has decided it is keeping us. There is a difference.
It eats what we do not. Have you seen what we do not?
property_rented: {ev_price} for one night under a roof at {ev_place}.
Worth every coin. Ask my back.
A room. An actual room with a door.
Enjoy it. Tomorrow is a hedge again.
work_shift: Honest and slow. I felt every hour of it.
I did not think I would end up doing {ev_job} for money.
Nobody ever thinks that. Then rent happens.
minigame_played: That was the most fun I have had in a month.
That is a bleak thing to hear and I agree with it.
I lost more than I should have at {ev_game}.
You always do. That is why you enjoy it.
travel_arrive: Well. We are here, wherever here turned out to be.
Give it an hour before you form an opinion.
The road took longer than they said it would.
The road always takes longer than they said.

opener: So we own {item} now. {price} gold, gone.
{item}. That is what we spent it on, in case anyone is keeping score.
Anyone want to talk about {item} and the {price} gold it cost us?
We bought {item}. It is in the pack. It is done.

nervous: And if we need that money before the next town? Because we might.
I would have kept the coin. Coin does not go wrong on you.
calm: It was needed. We will not think about the price in a week.
Fine. It is bought. Let us not spend the evening on it.
aggressive: Does it help us hit things? No? Then it was a waste.
I would have spent that on something with an edge.
melancholic: We will lose it in a field somewhere and never speak of it again.
Everything we buy ends up somewhere behind us. But go on, be pleased.
sanguine: Good. We were owed something that was not strictly necessary.
I like it. That is my whole opinion and I am sticking to it.
cautious: What are we now short of, exactly? That is the question nobody asked.
Was there a cheaper one? There is always a cheaper one.
impulsive: Why only one? We were already standing there.
I would have bought two and worked it out afterwards.
stoic: It changes nothing about tomorrow. Pack it and walk.
Bought is bought. The debating is the only wasted part.
paranoid: That merchant was too pleased with the sale. Think about why.
Check it before you rely on it. Check it twice.
empathetic: You wanted it. That is reason enough, and nobody here is going to say otherwise.
I saw your face when you picked it up. Keep it.
authoritative: Next time the purchase goes past me first. That is not a punishment, it is an arrangement.
Acceptable. But we are keeping a running total from now on.
scholarly: Do we actually know what it does, or did we buy the shopkeeper's description?
The price was above the market. I have been keeping the figures.
artistic: It is a beautiful thing. That is worth something even if it never gets used.
Look at the work in it. Somebody cared, once.
adventurous: It will earn its weight the first time we need it. Everything does out here.
Good. Buying things means we intend to still be here to use them.
nurturing: As long as it keeps somebody standing, it was cheap.
I would rather that in the pack than the coin in it. Coin never healed anyone.
mischievous: Did you haggle? You did not haggle. I can see it on you.
We could sell it two towns over for more. Just an observation.
cynical: We were robbed and we thanked them for it.
It will break, and we will buy another, and we will call that progress.
disciplined: That was not in the budget. There is a budget.
We eat on what is left. I hope it was worth the meals.
fatalistic: Spend it. None of it comes with us in the end.
It will not save us. But it will not hurt, and that is the standard now.
grumpy: Wonderful. More weight for me to carry.
Nobody asked me. Nobody ever asks me. Carry on.
loyal: If you thought we needed it, we needed it. That is the end of it.
I will carry it. Do not make a thing of the price.
brave: It is a tool. Tools are for using, so let us go and use it.
Stop counting coins and point me at whatever we bought it for.
timid: Was it all right to spend that much? Nobody minds? Really?
I would not have dared. I am glad somebody did.
hedonistic: A fine purchase. Now find me something to eat with the rest.
Money is for spending. This is the first sensible thing we have done all week.
apathetic: Whatever it was, it is bought. Wake me when we walk.
I have no opinion on {item}. I would like that on the record.
any: It is bought. Let us not stand here about it.
We will find out soon enough whether that was clever.

nervous: Did you hear that, or is it me again?
Tell me the plan. Just once more, out loud.
I keep checking the pack for something I know is in it.
calm: We are further on than we were this morning. That is the whole measure.
Sit down for a moment. The road will still be there.
You are winding yourself up over something that has not happened.
aggressive: Next thing that comes at us, I am not waiting to be asked.
You went easy back there. I saw it.
I am tired of being polite to people who would rob us.
melancholic: I was thinking about how few of us there are now.
Do you think anybody remembers the last place we stayed?
It is going to be one of those evenings. Ignore me.
sanguine: Say what you like, it is a good day to be out of doors.
We are alive, fed and moving. Three out of three.
I have decided this is going to go well. Do not argue.
cautious: Before we go any further. What is our way out of here?
I want to walk it once before we commit to it.
We are trusting a great deal to somebody we met yesterday.
impulsive: Let us just do it. Now, before anybody thinks about it.
I have had an idea and you are going to hate it.
Why are we still standing here discussing it?
stoic: It is weather. It will pass or it will not.
Complaining costs the same as walking and gets you less far.
We knew what this was when we started.
paranoid: Do not turn round. Two behind us since the last corner.
Somebody has been through my pack. Things are in the wrong order.
Why did they help us? Nobody helps for nothing.
empathetic: You have not been yourself since yesterday. Do not tell me you have.
Whatever it is, you can say it out here where nobody is listening.
You took that harder than you let on.
authoritative: We need an order of march and we need it before dark.
I want to hear everyone's objection now, not halfway across.
Somebody has to make the decision. It may as well be out loud.
scholarly: The stonework here is at least two centuries older than the rest.
I have been keeping notes. Do you want to hear them or shall I stop?
There is a pattern to where we keep finding these. I am nearly sure of it.
artistic: Look at the light on that. Just for a second. Look at it.
Somebody made that by hand, and then somebody else left it out here to rot.
I would like to remember this place properly, not just as somewhere we passed.
adventurous: There is a way up. I have already found it.
We could take the long road, or we could find out what is down there.
Aren't you even a little curious?
nurturing: You have not eaten since this morning. Do not think I did not notice.
Give me that arm. I am not asking.
Sit. I will take the next watch.
mischievous: I have not told you what I did in that last shop.
Say nothing when we get there. Follow my lead and try to look honest.
I bet you the next round I can get us in for free.
cynical: Let me guess how this ends. Badly, and we walk away with less.
They said the same thing in the last town. Word for word, almost.
Everyone out here is selling something. Even the ones giving it away.
disciplined: Kit check. Now, while there is light.
We keep the pace or we lose the day. It is arithmetic.
We agreed on a routine. We have not kept it in four days.
fatalistic: It will go the way it goes. It always has.
One of us is not going to make it out of this. Statistically speaking.
I stopped planning a long time ago and I have been happier.
grumpy: Whose idea was this road? I want a name.
I have been carrying this since dawn and nobody has offered.
Wake me when there is something worth waking for.
loyal: Whatever gets decided, I am with it.
I would not be standing here for anybody else. I hope that is understood.
You went back for me. I have not forgotten.
brave: I will go first. It is not a discussion.
If something is in there, better it meets me than you.
Stop looking for the safe way. There is not one.
timid: Could I walk in the middle? Just for this bit.
I do not want to be difficult, but I do not like this at all.
Is it all right if I say I am frightened?
hedonistic: The first thing I want in that town is a table and something hot on it.
We have money. Money is meant to leave.
Life is short and this road is long. Let us at least eat well.
apathetic: Do what you like. I am walking either way.
You are asking the wrong person for an opinion.
I stopped having preferences somewhere around the second town.
any: Long day.
Anything on your mind?

nervous: Do not say things like that out here.
Now I am going to be thinking about that all night.
Can we walk while we talk about this? Please.
calm: All right. And what would you like to do about it?
Noted. It is still not worth this much of your evening.
Breathe. Then say it again slower.
aggressive: Then somebody should have done something about it.
Talk is fine. I would rather have hit it.
Say the word and it stops being a problem.
melancholic: It will not matter in a year. None of this will.
You say that as though it is comforting.
I have been thinking the same thing and saying nothing.
sanguine: Well, I am choosing to enjoy it anyway.
That is one way to see it. Mine is nicer.
You worry beautifully. It is almost a talent.
cautious: And what happens if you are wrong?
Let us wait a day before we do anything about that.
I would like more than one way out before I agree.
impulsive: Then let us go now, while it is still true.
You think too long about everything.
stoic: Then it is so. What next?
I have heard worse and eaten dinner after.
paranoid: Who told you that? Think about who told you that.
That is exactly what somebody would want us to believe.
Keep your voice down. Everything out here has ears.
empathetic: That is not really what you meant, though, is it.
You do not have to carry that on your own.
I hear you. I am not going to pretend I have a fix.
authoritative: Then that is settled, and we do not revisit it.
I will decide. You will not like it and we will move on.
Bring it to me before it becomes everybody's problem.
scholarly: That is not quite right, and the correct version is more interesting.
I would want to see it written down before I believed it.
There is a word for that. It will come to me.
